programs.desc: Join Dr Harry Cooper and Dr Katrina Warren for everything you need to know about animals.

programs.title: RSPCA Animal Rescue
programs.desc: A lorikeet found hanging by fishing line in a tall tree is rescued by inspectors and rehabilitated by in-mates at a correctional centre.

programs.desc: Jules Hudson is on a property searching mission spanning the Somerset and Devon's Exmoor National Park with a couple who have 550,000 pounds and a love of carpentry and the coast.

programs.title: Bargain Hunt
programs.desc: Natasha Raskin Sharp heads to Malvern, where experts Thomas Forrester and Tim Weeks help the teams find the best items to sell at auction in Staffordshire.

programs.title: The Yorkshire Vet
programs.desc: Peter Wright treats a pet sheep with an unpleasant case of flystrike, resulting in an abundance of maggots living within its ear. Elsewhere, the Huddersfield team perform complicated spinal surgery on a French bulldog, and Julian Norton is called out to meet a pet pig called Pumba that has hay netting tangled around its teeth.
